description: Introduction and overview of the Eurofighter Typhoon: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Eurofighter Typhoon is a twin-engine multirole fighter built by the Eurofighter consortium (UK, Germany, Italy, Spain), entering service in 2003. Its delta wing plus canards give exceptional agility, and later upgrades added full air-to-ground capability. About 570 have been built for European and Middle Eastern air forces. Baseline facts: Twin-engine multirole fighter; service from 2003; ~570 built by the Eurofighter consortium..
